research_question: What is the effect of shared decision-making interventions focused only on enhanced communication (without a component clarifying patient values and preferences), compared with control, on patient knowledge (measured on a continuous scale)?
outcome_description: Patient knowledge regarding medical condition, options, risks, and benefits measured on a continuous scale
positive_direction: Positive values indicate higher patient knowledge favoring the enhanced-communication shared decision-making intervention over control
search_queries: shared decision making enhanced communication patient knowledge trial
shared decision making communication intervention knowledge controlled trial
decision support communication patient knowledge randomized comparison
inclusion_criteria: Empirical controlled trials or comparative studies evaluating shared decision-making interventions focused on enhanced communication without patient values-clarification components
Comparison with a control group (e.g., usual care, attention control, or standard information)
Quantitative measurement of patient knowledge on a continuous scale with extractable effect size data
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study (e.g., systematic reviews, meta-analyses, narrative reviews, editorials, commentaries, or study protocols)
Interventions that include explicit patient values-clarification exercises or do not focus on enhanced communication
No comparison between an eligible enhanced-communication shared decision-making intervention and a control condition
No quantitative continuous outcome data available for patient knowledge (e.g., lacking means, SDs, sample sizes, or convertible test statistics)
moderators_to_extract: Clinical domain / decision context (e.g., oncology, cardiology, primary care, screening)
Intervention delivery format (e.g., clinician training, patient-facing decision tool, digital/multimedia)
Type of control condition (e.g., usual care vs. active information control)
Timing of knowledge outcome assessment (e.g., immediate post-intervention vs. delayed follow-up)
effect_size_note: Standardized mean difference (SMD, Hedges' g) pooled across studies reporting continuous knowledge scores measured with varied instruments.
